segments: Deuteronomy 6:7 Uh-huh. And thou shalt
teach them diligently unto thy children,
and shalt talk of them when thou sitest
in thine house, and when thou walst by
the way, and when thou liest down, and
when thou riseest up. Every opportunity
that you get, you're supposed to teach
your children. Use everything as a
teaching tool. Even when you go out here
in public, even when you see one of
these emasculate men, these these
feminine men wearing dresses and skirts
and wigs and lipstick, use that man as
an example. Like, son, you see that? You
know that's wrong as hell, right? You
know, a man is not supposed to dress
like that, right? You know, a man is not
supposed to walk like that. A man
carries himself like this, son. That's
why I tell you, when you walk into the
store, you have your chest up. You have
your shoulders back. You walk into that
store like you own it.
